  RootPackage
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "float_from_bits")
  fun fromFloatBits(value: UInt): Float
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "double_from_bits")
  fun fromDoubleBits(value: ULong): Double
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "float_bits")
  fun floatBits(value: Float): UInt
    @Extern(lib = "fixture_native", name = "double_bits")
  fun doubleBits(value: Double): ULong
  fun multiplyAdd(a: Float, b: Float, c: Float): Float
    =
      Binary Add
        Binary Mul
          Var a
          Var b
        Var c
  fun multiplyAdd(a: Double, b: Double, c: Double): Double
    =
      Binary Add
        Binary Mul
          Var a
          Var b
        Var c
  fun addThenSubtract(a: Float, b: Float): Float
    =
      Binary Sub
        Binary Add
          Var a
          Var b
        Var b
  fun addThenSubtract(a: Double, b: Double): Double
    =
      Binary Sub
        Binary Add
          Var a
          Var b
        Var b
  fun reflexive(value: Float): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        Var value
        Var value
  fun reflexive(value: Double): Boolean
    =
      Binary Eq
        Var value
        Var value
    @Unsafe
  fun main()
    val single
      Call multiplyAdd
        Call fromFloatBits
          IntLiteral 0x3f800001u
        Call fromFloatBits
          IntLiteral 0x3f7ffffeu
        Unary Neg
          FloatLiteral 1f
    val wide
      Call multiplyAdd
        Call fromDoubleBits
          IntLiteral 0x3ff0000000000001uL
        Call fromDoubleBits
          IntLiteral 0x3feffffffffffffeuL
        Unary Neg
          FloatLiteral 1.0
    if
      Binary Or
        Binary Ne
          Call floatBits
            Var single
          IntLiteral 0u
        Binary Ne
          Call doubleBits
            Var wide
          IntLiteral 0uL
      Call println
        StringLiteral "fused"
      return
    val largeSingle
      Call fromFloatBits
        IntLiteral 0x7f7fffffu
    val largeWide
      Call fromDoubleBits
        IntLiteral 0x7fefffffffffffffuL
    if
      Binary Or
        Unary Not
          MethodCall isInfinite
            Call addThenSubtract
              Var largeSingle
              Var largeSingle
        Unary Not
          MethodCall isInfinite
            Call addThenSubtract
              Var largeWide
              Var largeWide
      Call println
        StringLiteral "reassociated"
      return
    val quietSingle
      Call fromFloatBits
        IntLiteral 0x7fc00042u
    val quietWide
      Call fromDoubleBits
        IntLiteral 0x7ff8000000000042uL
    if
      Binary Or
        Call reflexive
          Var quietSingle
        Call reflexive
          Var quietWide
      Call println
        StringLiteral "nan"
      return
    val negativeSingle
      Call fromFloatBits
        IntLiteral 0x80000000u
    val negativeWide
      Call fromDoubleBits
        IntLiteral 0x8000000000000000uL
    if
      Binary Or
        Binary Ne
          Call floatBits
            Call multiplyAdd
              Var negativeSingle
              FloatLiteral 1f
              Var negativeSingle
          IntLiteral 0x80000000u
        Binary Ne
          Call doubleBits
            Call multiplyAdd
              Var negativeWide
              FloatLiteral 1.0
              Var negativeWide
          IntLiteral 0x8000000000000000uL
      Call println
        StringLiteral "zero"
      return
    Call println
      StringLiteral "rounding-ok"
